senses.en_definition: Kaveriamma, an attested personal name; no ordinary Malay lexical meaning is established for this record.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang dieja Kaveriamma; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu tidak dapat disahkan daripada bahan yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 学校原始文件证实 Kaveriamma 用作人名，但不能确定输入语料具体指谁。未核实为 DBP 普通词条，因此不标记 official。以下搭配及例句用于演示专名的句法位置，并非已证实的高频搭配或真实人物事迹。[Teresian College：会议记录](https://www.teresiancollege.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Feedback-Department-Meeting.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sila semak ejaan nama Kaveriamma sebelum surat jemputan dikeluarkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 请在发出邀请函之前核对 Kaveriamma 这一姓名的拼写。
dual_scenarios.en: Please check the spelling of Kaveriamma's name before the invitation letter is issued.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nama dia Kaveriamma, kan? Aku nak pastikan ejaannya je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Namanya Kaveriamma, bukan? Saya hanya mahu memastikan ejaannya betul.
dual_scenarios.zh: 她叫 Kaveriamma，对吧？我只是想确认一下拼写。
dual_scenarios.en: Her name's Kaveriamma, right? I just want to check the spelling.

nak 对应 mahu，je 对应 sahaja。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah semak nama Kaveriamma kat senarai tu?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah menyemak nama Kaveriamma dalam senarai itu?
messages.zh: 你核对过名单上 Kaveriamma 的名字了吗？
messages.en: Have you checked Kaveriamma's name on the list?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, tapi aku nak sahkan ejaannya dengan dia dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, tetapi saya mahu mengesahkan ejaannya dengan beliau terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 核对过了，不过我想先跟她本人确认拼写。
messages.en: Yes, but I'd like to confirm the spelling with her first.

etymology.historical_story: Kaveriamma is documented as a personal name in institutional records from a college in Mysuru, India. That evidence establishes name usage, but it does not identify the person intended by this packet or establish the name's precise linguistic origin. A responsible entry therefore preserves the spelling without inventing a Malay derivation, pronunciation, or translated meaning. [Teresian College：会议记录](https://www.teresiancollege.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/Feedback-Department-Meeting.pdf)
